text: In May, nineteen fifty-three, a Comet broke up in a violent storm near Calcutta. In January, nineteen fifty-four, another came apart at about twenty-seven thousand feet, over the sea near the island of Elba. The Comets were grounded, checked over, and cleared to fly again. Just two weeks later, a third Comet broke up over the sea near Naples. Nobody on any of the three flights survived.
